profile_text.body:
Credo AI, founded in 2020, provides an AI governance platform. Its website describes the company as the trusted leader in AI governance and says it created the AI governance category. The platform is presented as a way for enterprises to discover AI systems, enforce policies, prove compliance, and manage risk across models, agents, and applications. The company says its approach uses a knowledge graph that combines global regulatory intelligence with business context, and it offers policy packs for the EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF, ISO 42001, and other standards.

The platform includes GAIA, a Govern AI Assistant that the company says compresses weeks of governance work into hours. Credo AI describes agent governance as a focus, with agents registered, risk-assessed, sanctioned, and governed as first-class entities. The company states that its policy packs were written by people involved in standards bodies including ISO, NIST, the EU Parliament, NATO, and OECD. Customer quotes on the site reference Mastercard and IBM, among others.

The product information describes Credo AI as purpose-built AI governance with policy packs for the EU AI Act and NIST AI RMF, a clean interface, and fast deployment. The company says enterprises across insurance, financial services, federal, and healthcare are already scaling on it.
